MAINTENANCE
CLASSIC
Oct 19, 2026
SCHEDULED GRAND LAUNCH - OCTOBER 21, 2026

We will be performing a scheduled maintenance starting on Wednesday, October 21, 2026 at 6:00 AM PDT (9:00 AM EDT / 3:00 PM CEST / 12:00 AM AEDT October 22). We anticipate the maintenance to last approximately 5 hours, concluding around 11:00 AM PDT (2:00 PM EDT / 8:00 PM CEST / 5:00 AM AEDT October 22).

Times:

Wednesday, October 21, 2026
PDT (UTC -7): 6:00 AM - 11:00 AM
EDT (UTC -4): 9:00 AM - 2:00 PM
CEST (UTC +2): 3:00 PM - 8:00 PM
AEDT (UTC +11): 12:00 AM October 22 - 5:00 AM October 22

What will be unavailable:

All MapleStory Classic World game servers.

Changes and Updates:

MapleStory Classic World will be updated to v.1.0.0.
Monthly Windows Update.

Grand Launch release notes will be available soon!
Additional details on changes and updates will be posted here after maintenance is complete.

items.title: maintenanceClassicOct 15, 2026[Completed] Scheduled Minor Patch Maintenance - October 15, 2026The maintenance has been completed and we have extended Cash Shop items in your inventory for 3 hours.
items.body:
MAINTENANCE
CLASSIC
Oct 15, 2026
[COMPLETED] SCHEDULED MINOR PATCH MAINTENANCE - OCTOBER 15, 2026

[Updated October 15 at 10:50 AM PDT] The maintenance has been completed and we have extended Cash Shop items in your inventory for 3 hours. Please restart your Nexon Launcher or Steam to ensure you receive the latest client update.

We will be performing a scheduled maintenance starting on Thursday, October 15, 2026 at 8:00 AM PDT (11:00 AM EDT / 5:00 PM CEST / 2:00 AM AEDT October 16). We anticipate the maintenance to last approximately 3 hours, concluding around 11:00 AM PDT (2:00 PM EDT / 8:00 PM CEST / 5:00 AM AEDT October 16).

Times:

Thursday, October 15, 2026
PDT (UTC -7): 8:00 AM - 11:00 AM
EDT (UTC -4): 11:00 AM - 2:00 PM
CEST (UTC +2): 5:00 PM - 8:00 PM
AEDT (UTC +11): 2:00 AM October 16 - 5:00 AM October 16

What will be unavailable:

All MapleStory Classic World game servers.

Changes and Updates:

Korean (Beta) has been added as a display language option, available alongside English and Spanish (Beta) in the login and game settings.
Chat now only allows text characters supported by English, Spanish, and Korean. Text from unsupported languages can no longer be used in chat.
[Updated 10/15/2026] Megaphones and similar items will continue to support English text only.
The Shield Guard sound effect has been changed.
The Kerning City map has been adjusted to make the Kerning City Civic Center easier to reach.
The Maple Administrator NPC has been added to Kerning City.
The Beauty Album confirmation message has been added to make it clearer that your current look will be saved to the selected slot when applying a saved look.
The Store Permit listing UI has been improved to clearly show the number of items registered when listing items for sale.

Bug Fixes:

Resolved an issue where players could use a Store Permit while Dark Sight was active, causing the opened shop to be invisible to other players.
Resolved an issue where unsold items would not immediately return to the player’s inventory after closing a Store Permit shop.
Resolved an issue where the game client would sometimes disconnect when attacking a monster with Arrow Bomb or Poison Breath.
Resolved an issue where the game client would sometimes disconnect when picking up an item that a pet was attempting to loot before being dismissed.
Resolved an issue where the game client would sometimes disconnect when clicking 'OK' on a trade confirmation after the other player had canceled the trade.
Resolved an issue where the game client would sometimes disconnect when removing a 0 stack throwing star from storage.
Resolved an issue where, upon a new character’s first login, the game client would sometimes disconnect when clicking 'OK' on the popup.
Resolved an issue where the game client would sometimes disconnect when using Heal on party members near Zombie Mushrooms in the Ant Tunnel.
Resolved an issue where launcher login failures would close the game client without displaying the reason for the failure.
Resolved an issue where players would sometimes be unable to exit the Cash Shop.
Resolved an issue where the Bandit skill Steal could trigger meso and item drops, steal an item, and grant its buff even when the attack missed.
Resolved an issue where monsters defeated by damage over time (DoT) effects, such as burn or bleed, would grant double EXP and item drops.
Resolved an issue where boss monsters could incorrectly be knocked back by certain skills.
Resolved an issue where 100% Enhancement scrolls could not be used on items due to the "Lucky Day effect".
Resolved an issue where Woodcrafting certain items that should not give crafting EXP would give EXP when using a Woodcrafting Kit. 
Resolved an issue where pets would not pick up stackable Etc. items when all inventory slots were full, even if there was still room in an existing stack.
Resolved an issue where the Detective Glass and Soft Chocolate Fondue Scepter would sometimes appear invisible when equipped over certain two-handed weapons.
Resolved an issue where the Iron Body and Magic Armor afterimage would appear to drift away from the character.
Resolved an issue where certain character names would incorrectly display on two lines when the White Label Ring was equipped.
Resolved an issue where a rope in The Murky Swamp could not be climbed.
Resolved an issue where some platforms in Perion: West Rocky Mountain IV were invisible.
Resolved an issue where the Dark Sight skill description incorrectly displayed Level 1 Disorder as a requirement instead of Level 3 Disorder.
Resolved a text issue where the Event NPC Paul’s dialogue incorrectly displayed a reference to the Closed Online Test when selecting “What kind of an event is it?”
Resolved a text issue where the 'Dr. Betty’s Research on Plant Fossils' quest incorrectly stated that 20 samples were required instead of 8.
Resolved a text issue where the Pet Booster Essentials Pack incorrectly displayed a message stating that the included pet skills could not be learned by the player’s current pet.
items.bodyZh: 维护 经典 2026年10月15日 [已完成] 计划性小型补丁维护 - 2026年10月15日 [更新于10月15日上午10:50 PDT（北京时间 2026年10月16日 凌晨1:50）] 维护已完成，我们已将您背包中的现金商店物品延长了3小时。请重启您的Nexon Launcher或Steam以确保您收到最新的客户端更新。 我们将于2026年10月15日星期四上午8:00 PDT（北京时间 2026年10月15日 晚上11:00）（上午11:00 EDT / 下午5:00 CEST / 10月16日凌晨2:00 AEDT）开始进行计划性维护。我们预计维护将持续约3小时，大约在上午11:00 PDT（北京时间 2026年10月16日 凌晨2:00）（下午2:00 EDT / 晚上8:00 CEST / 10月16日凌晨5:00 AEDT）结束。 时间详情： 2026年10月15日，星期四 * 北京时间 (UTC +8): 10月15日 晚上11:00 - 10月16日 凌晨2:00 * 太平洋夏令时 (UTC -7): 上午8:00 - 上午11:00 * 东部夏令时 (UTC -4): 上午11:00 - 下午2:00 * 中欧夏令时 (UTC +2): 下午5:00 - 晚上8:00 * 澳大利亚东部夏令时 (UTC +11): 10月16日 凌晨2:00 - 10月16日 凌晨5:00 不可用内容： 所有MapleStory Classic World游戏服务器。 变更与更新： 韩语（Beta）已作为显示语言选项添加，可在登录和游戏设置中与英语和西班牙语（Beta）一起使用。 聊天现在仅允许使用英语、西班牙语和韩语支持的文本字符。不支持的语言的文本将无法再在聊天中使用。 [更新于2026年10月15日] 喇叭及类似物品将继续仅支持英文文本。 盾牌防御音效已更改。 废弃都市地图已调整，使废弃都市市政中心更容易到达。 枫之管理员NPC已添加到废弃都市。 美容相册确认消息已添加，以更清楚地表明在应用已保存的外观时，您当前的外观将保存到所选槽位。 商店许可证上架UI已改进，在上架物品出售时清晰显示已登记物品数量。 错误修复： 修复了玩家在暗影潜伏激活时可以使用商店许可证，导致开设的商店对其他玩家不可见的问题。 修复了关闭商店许可证商店后，未售出物品不会立即返回玩家背包的问题。 修复了使用箭矢爆破或毒雾攻击怪物时，游戏客户端有时会断开连接的问题。 修复了拾取宠物在解散前试图拾取的物品时，游戏客户端有时会断开连接的问题。 修复了在对方玩家已取消交易后，点击交易确认的“确定”时，游戏客户端有时会断开连接的问题。 修复了从仓库中取出0堆叠飞镖时，游戏客户端有时会断开连接的问题。 修复了新角色首次登录时，点击弹窗上的“确定”时，游戏客户端有时会断开连接的问题。 修复了在蚂蚁洞窟中对僵尸蘑菇附近的队友使用治愈术时，游戏客户端有时会断开连接的问题。 修复了启动器登录失败会关闭游戏客户端而不显示失败原因的问题。 修复了玩家有时无法退出现金商店的问题。 修复了盗贼技能偷窃在攻击未命中时仍能触发金币和物品掉落、窃取物品并给予其增益效果的问题。 修复了被持续伤害（DoT）效果（如燃烧或流血）击败的怪物会给予双倍经验值和物品掉落的问题。 修复了Boss怪物可能被某些技能错误击退的问题。 修复了100%强化卷轴因“幸运日效果”而无法在物品上使用的问题。 修复了使用木工工具制作某些不应给予制作经验值的物品时会给予经验值的问题。 修复了当所有背包槽位已满时，即使现有堆叠中仍有空间，宠物也不会拾取可堆叠的其它物品的问题。 修复了侦探眼镜和软巧克力火锅权杖在装备于某些双手武器上时有时会显示为不可见的问题。 修复了铁甲和魔法护盾残影会看起来偏离角色的问题。 修复了装备白色标签戒指时，某些角色名称会错误地显示为两行的问题。 修复了浑浊沼泽中的一根绳子无法攀爬的问题。 修复了勇士部落：西部岩山IV中的一些平台不可见的问题。 修复了暗影潜伏技能描述错误地显示需要1级混乱术而非3级混乱术的问题。 修复了文本问题，即活动NPC保罗的对话在选择“这是什么活动？”时错误地显示了对封闭在线测试的引用。 修复了文本问题，即“贝蒂博士的植物化石研究”任务错误地声明需要20个样本而非8个。 修复了文本问题，即宠物增强 essentials 包错误地显示了一条消息，称包含的宠物技能无法被玩家当前宠物学习。

items.title: maintenanceOct 13, 2026v.271 Known IssuesHere you’ll find a list of known and resolved issues from the v.271 - MapleStory x Frieren: Beyond Journey's End update.
items.body:
MAINTENANCE
Oct 13, 2026
V.271 KNOWN ISSUES

The Known Issues section focuses on the major issues that have significantly impacted the game and community, and which our team is actively addressing. Please note that while we aim to cover the most impactful issues, this list will not encompass every reported issue. Check back regularly for updates on the status of these issues and information on resolved issues, or any new issues that may have been added.

Here you’ll find a list of known and resolved issues from the v.271 - MapleStory x Frieren: Beyond Journey's End update:

KNOWN ISSUES:
We have identified an issue where using Group Chairs may intermittently cause problems. Group Chairs will be disabled until the next maintenance.
Kazax's Energy Fragments and Inspector Boxes obtained from the Ride or Die event could not be opened even though the items had not expired.
For affected players, these items will be compensated in a future maintenance.
MacOS users who have updated to macOS 27 Golden Gate are unable to access MapleStory through Steam.
We advise players to download and install MapleStory directly from the Nexon Launcher, which will prompt the Rosetta install needed to access the game. Once Rosetta is installed, MapleStory can be accessed from Steam as normal.
RESOLVED ISSUES:

October 13, 2026

Resolved an issue where players were unable to enter the Yeti’s Night event map.

October 12, 2026

Resolved an issue where Grandis Daily Quests did not grant Sol Erda rewards upon choosing not to collect the Grandis Symbol.
Affected players will receive the missing Sol Erda rewards during a future maintenance.

September 30, 2026

Resolved an issue where the Information Viewer '?' button in the [Night Troupe] Mesotron-S Project event displayed a 404 error.

September 21, 2026

Resolved an issue where some players were unable to World Leap due to pending Meso Market Transactions.
Meso or Maple Points for affected players will be distributed at a later date. 

September 17, 2026

Resolved an issue where Night Lord and Ren characters would disconnect when entering Phase 3 of Kaling.
Resolved an issue where the Symbol Selector Coupon's item description incorrectly displays as "Sacred Symbol Selector Coupons x2" instead of x1.
Resolved an issue where some players were unable to World Leap from Challenger World.
Resolved an issue where some players were unable to World Leap due to an error stating "You haven't checked the results of your previously registered Mystic Frontier Champion Lineup yet. Check the results first."
Resolved an issue where Princess No would not attack.
Resolved an issue where the Guild Board UI contained untranslated text.
Resolved an issue where Sacred Symbol Selectors obtained from the Weekly Guild Castle Missions could not be used.
Resolved an issue where the Frieren NPC text titles contained Spanish text.
Resolved an issue where after using Mercedes's Spirit of Elluel skill, the cooldown would not decrease after using a linked skill.
Resolved an issue where Demon Avenger characters interacting with Mastema during a Job Advancement quest could cause the client to disconnect.
Resolved an issue where Sol Hecate would stop attacking after using Phlegethon while Styx was bound to the Terms and Conditions.
Resolved an issue where the client would sometimes disconnect when using Star Cores on Gollux Gear in Veritas.
Resolved an issue where the Guiding Stars link skill would not properly apply when logging in.
Resolved an issue where the Power Cycle in Phase 2 of First Adversary message contained untranslated text.
Resolved an issue where the Legion buff item icons incorrectly displayed "Union" instead of "Legion".
Resolved an issue where the Animation toggle effects were reversed in the Enhance UI.
Resolved an issue where Erel characters could not add the Tree of Stars skill to their Buff Favorites UI.
Resolved an issue where the Random Mimic Box obtained from the 'Adventure with Frieren's Companions' event displayed an incorrect description.
Resolved an issue where characters who have not completed Monster Park Extreme are unable to use the Monster Park Extreme Express Pass Ticket.

September 18, 2026

Resolved an issue where Erel Light characters were unable to start the 2nd Job Advancement quest. Players who were unable to complete the 2nd Job Advancement can do so through the Maple Administrator.

September 10, 2026

Resolved an issue where Glowing Cubes were not working as intended when used on Hats with Legendary Potential after the v271 Patch. Potential resets using Cubes has been re-enabled.
Glowing Cubes used on Hats with Legendary Potential after the v.271 patch and before Potential resets were temporarily disabled have been distributed via the Gift Drop and can be claimed for three weeks. Glowing Cubes are untradable and have a 30-day duration.
Resolved an issue where the key binds would overlap when assigning a new key bind to quickslot UI.
Resolved an issue where players would disconnect from client when using Ascent skills in Black Mage.

September 9, 2026

Tallahart Fantasia Check-In Event
Players who were unable to check in at 55 and 56 check-ins during the Fantasia Finale week will have their missed rewards distributed via Maple Administrator following the maintenance on September 9, 2026.
Resolved an issue where some players were unable to purchase a Kinetic Pass.
The Kinetic event has been extended until September 15, 2026 at 11:59 PM UTC and can be accessed by talking to Maple Administrator.
items.bodyZh:
维护
2026年10月12日
V.271 已知问题

已知问题部分主要关注对游戏和社区产生重大影响、且我们团队正在积极处理的问题。请注意，虽然我们力求涵盖影响最大的问题，但此列表不会包含所有已报告的问题。请定期查看，以获取这些问题的最新状态、已解决问题以及可能新增问题的相关信息。

以下为 v.271 - 冒险岛 x 葬送的芙莉莲 更新中的已知问题和已解决问题列表：

已知问题：
我们已确认使用组队椅子时可能间歇性出现问题。组队椅子将在下次维护前禁用。
从 Ride or Die 活动中获得的 Kazax's Energy Fragments 和 Inspector Boxes 即使未过期也无法打开。
对于受影响的玩家，这些物品将在未来的维护中补偿。
已更新至 macOS 27 Golden Gate 的 MacOS 用户无法通过 Steam 访问冒险岛。
我们建议玩家直接从 Nexon Launcher 下载并安装冒险岛，这将提示安装访问游戏所需的 Rosetta。安装 Rosetta 后，即可正常通过 Steam 访问冒险岛。
已解决问题：

2026年10月12日

修复了 Grandis 日常任务在选择不收集 Grandis Symbol 时不给予 Sol Erda 奖励的问题。
受影响的玩家将在未来的维护中收到缺失的 Sol Erda 奖励。

2026年9月30日

修复了 [Night Troupe] Mesotron-S Project 活动中信息查看器“？”按钮显示 404 错误的问题。

2026年9月21日

修复了部分玩家因待处理的枫币市场交易而无法进行世界飞跃的问题。
受影响玩家的枫币或枫叶点数将在稍后发放。

2026年9月17日

修复了夜行者和 Erel 角色在进入 Kaling 第三阶段时断开连接的问题。
修复了符号选择券的物品描述错误显示为“Sacred Symbol Selector Coupons x2”而非 x1 的问题。
修复了部分玩家无法从 Challenger World 进行世界飞跃的问题。
修复了部分玩家因错误提示“You haven't checked the results of your previously registered Mystic Frontier Champion Lineup yet. Check the results first.”而无法进行世界飞跃的问题。
修复了 Princess No 不攻击的问题。
修复了公会公告板 UI 包含未翻译文本的问题。
修复了从每周公会城堡任务获得的 Sacred Symbol Selectors 无法使用的问题。
修复了 Frieren NPC 文本标题包含西班牙语文本的问题。
修复了使用 Mercedes 的 Spirit of Elluel 技能后，使用链接技能时冷却时间不减少的问题。
修复了 Demon Avenger 角色在职业进阶任务中与 Mastema 互动时可能导致客户端断开连接的问题。
修复了 Sol Hecate 在 Styx 绑定至 Terms and Conditions 时使用 Phlegethon 后停止攻击的问题。
修复了在 Veritas 中对 Gollux 装备使用 Star Cores 时客户端有时会断开连接的问题。
修复了 Guiding Stars 链接技能在登录时无法正确应用的问题。
修复了 First Adversary 第二阶段 Power Cycle 消息包含未翻译文本的问题。
修复了联盟增益物品图标错误显示为“Union”而非“Legion”的问题。
修复了增强 UI 中动画切换效果反转的问题。
修复了 Erel 角色无法将 Tree of Stars 技能添加到增益收藏 UI 的问题。
修复了从“Adventure with Frieren's Companions”活动中获得的 Random Mimic Box 显示错误描述的问题。
修复了未完成怪物公园极限的角色无法使用怪物公园极限快速通行证的问题。

2026年9月18日

修复了 Erel Light 角色无法开始第二次职业进阶任务的问题。无法完成第二次职业进阶的玩家可通过 Maple Administrator 完成。

2026年9月10日

修复了 v271 补丁后，对传说潜能帽子使用 Glowing Cubes 时未按预期生效的问题。使用魔方重置潜能已重新启用。
在 v.271 补丁后、潜能重置暂时禁用前，对传说潜能帽子使用的 Glowing Cubes 已通过 Gift Drop 发放，可在三周内领取。Glowing Cubes 不可交易，有效期为 30 天。
修复了为快捷栏 UI 分配新键位时键位重叠的问题。
修复了在黑魔法师中使用 Ascent 技能时玩家与客户端断开连接的问题。

2026年9月9日

Tallahart Fantasia 签到活动
在 Fantasia Finale 周期间无法在第 55 和 56 次签到进行签到的玩家，其缺失的奖励将在 2026年9月9日维护后通过 Maple Administrator 发放。
修复了部分玩家无法购买 Kinetic Pass 的问题。
Kinetic 活动已延长至 2026年9月15日 晚上11:59 UTC，可通过与 Maple Administrator 对话进入。
